title: At 81, the UN is only just alive—as ever
gist: Adonis argues the UN will survive Trump 'battered and emaciated': Trump paid ~$827m of US arrears to keep General Assembly voting rights and is going along with the secretary-general succession, while culling peacekeeping (Lebanon withdrawal, Gaza 'Board of Peace'). The UN's value is as a neutral forum, illustrated by Burnham, Zelensky and Takaichi meeting Trump there.
